card.name: The word hepatitis before B or C
card.fires_on: The word hepatitis, or its pieces (Hep, atitis, HEPATIT, IS), right before the virus letter B or C. Seen in warnings about reactivation, co-infection and screening.

card.plain: It fires on the word hepatitis when the next thing to appear is the virus type, B or C.
